results.description:
Wicker_Basket
***고리***
Goriyanagi is a round, flat ring made of goriyanagi. Goriyanagi is a shrub belonging to the willow family that grows naturally near water. It is 1 to 3 meters high and has a separate male and female number. To make a basket bowl for branches, a thin wicker is densely woven to make a bowl, and then a wide wooden board is placed inside and outside, and four places are sewn with pine needles. The upper layer is deeply covered with the lower layer. It can be used to store cloth or books, and it can also be used as a rice cake container for large events such as weddings and rituals. 설명출처 :한국민족문화대백과사전

results.name: Indonesian Food Dessert Klepon
results.description:
**Klepon** is a traditional Indonesian sweet rice cake, typically enjoyed as a snack or dessert. It is made from glutinous rice flour dough that is colored green with pandan juice and filled with palm sugar. The dough is then shaped into small balls and boiled until they become soft and chewy. After boiling, the klepon is rolled in freshly grated coconut, which gives it a pleasant texture and added flavor.

When you bite into klepon, the warm, gooey palm sugar inside bursts out, providing a sweet and satisfying treat. This snack is popular in Indonesia, Malaysia, and Singapore and is often served at celebrations, traditional markets, or as a part of festive offerings. The combination of sweet, savory, and coconut flavors makes klepon a beloved delicacy across Southeast Asia.

results.name: Mochi soup / Ozoni
results.description:
Ozoni (お雑煮) is a traditional Japanese soup featuring mochi (rice cakes). It is mostly eaten during the New Year to bring good fortune and health. The soup base varies—often made with soy sauce or miso—and is typically filled with vegetables, chicken, or seafood.

This is my stylized food model for practicing using Blender for modeling that I did it during free time after work. Enjoy!! ^^

results.name: Wooden_Tray
results.description:
Wooden_Tray
***목판***
A vessel used to hold or transport rice cakes or fruit. It is also called a seedbed because it is made of square wooden boards. The front is tilted outward by about 45°, and the inside and outside are lacquered. The materials used are mainly jujube trees and birch trees. The shape varies from rectangular, square, octagonal, etc., and the size varies from around 1 to 2 m to around 10 m. Sometimes, there are extravagant ones with wooden plate ears and brass decorations, and sometimes 10 to 12 pieces are stacked together like a multi-story pagoda in a temple. Explanation Source : Encyclopedia of Korean Culture

results.name: Ang Ku Kueh Mould
results.description:
**Accession Number:** 2010-00829

**Year/Period:** Early 20th century

**Dimension:** L 26 x W 9.5 x H 6 cm

**Region:** Singapore and British Malaya

**Collection of:** Peranakan Museum

This is a wooden mould used in the making of *ang ku kueh* (red tortoise cake), which is a common Peranakan Chinese snack. With a sweet central filling wrapped in glutinous rice flour skin that is traditionally red in colour, it is typically enjoyed during festive occasions such as Chinese New Year. This is because red is an auspicious colour in Chinese culture, symbolising good fortune and prosperity. Learn more at [roots.sg](https://www.roots.gov.sg/Collection-Landing/listing/1243898).
